package.name: nros_runner_qemu
package.description:
The `qemu` runner (RFC-0119 D8). Runs an image under QEMU. The machine line is rendered from the plan's QEMU args by the one QEMU ladder renderer, and QEMU itself is the plan's tool, resolved by nros through the SDK store, never PATH.
A runner package of the same shape as a user's: the announcement below is what the provider scan reads, `nros-runner.toml` is read only when this provider is the one selected, and the executable speaks RFC-0119 D6.
